heading: Protection of Federal Government buildings in District of Columbia
lead: The Attorney General and the Secretary of the Treasury may prohibit—

tree.text: a vehicle from parking or standing on a street or roadway adjacent to a building in the District of Columbia—

children.text: at least partly owned or possessed by, or leased to, the Federal Government; and
used by law enforcement authorities subject to their jurisdiction; and

tree.text: a person or entity from conducting business on property immediately adjacent to a building described in paragraph (1).
